def find_prior_date(row):
    student_id = row[student_id_1_col]
    submission_date = row[submission_date_col]
    if pd.isna(student_id) or pd.isna(submission_date):

    # Filter Table 1 for the same student and dates before submission date
    mask = (df[student_id_col] == student_id) & (df[visit_date_col] < submission_date)
    prior_dates = df.loc[mask, visit_date_col]
    
    if not prior_dates.empty:
        return prior_dates.max()
    return pd.NaT

# Apply the function to all rows and populate the 'Visit date.1' column (Column J)
